verdict.rationale: The only relevant item is the Cyber/Data/Privacy practice page. It describes general counseling on privacy, cybersecurity and data protection, plus due diligence reviews for transactions. Nothing in the pack documents security-incident or breach response, or regulator-facing work such as notifications or investigations, so the cyber practice is only adjacent to this story.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm handles security-incident and breach response, including regulator-facing work, documented on its own pages
